name: McBE: Multi-task Chinese Bias Evaluation Benchmark
description: A multi-task benchmark for evaluating biases in large language models grounded in Chinese language and culture. It includes 4,077 bias evaluation instances covering 12 bias categories and 82 subcategories across 5 evaluation tasks, providing extensive coverage and measuring comprehensiveness.
reputation: A recent ACL Findings benchmark that is gaining attention for Chinese bias evaluation, but it is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Addresses scarcity of Chinese language and culture bias datasets; supports multiple evaluation tasks and extensive bias categories.
